title: GrantResidual
description:
⟨M06; ADR-0012 §7.3⟩ The residual of one grant this controller asked a runner to
revoke, from this controller's counted issuance history (A07's report).

acknowledged.description: Whether the runner acknowledged the revoke (`false`: still `remote_pending`).

new_authentication.description: New authentication. Omitted when nothing counted is outstanding.

statement.description: The same in words, never a bare deadline. Wording unchanged from revision 6.

AuthenticationResidual.description:
⟨M06⟩ Revision 6 (ADR-0012 §7.3, §9 item 10): the new-authentication residual of a
revocation. Its bound comes from the counted issuance history (reserved and published
certificates count until their `valid_before`) plus the destination clock's error;
where that error is unmeasured the residual reads "until `valid_before` plus an
unmeasured destination-clock error", never a bare deadline.

destination_clock_error.description:
The destination clock's error: `{"measured": {…}}` (its bound is
`behind_upper_ms`) or `"unmeasured"`.

latest_possible_credential_expiry.description:
The latest instant a counted certificate stays valid; absent: `unknown` (no counted
history for the grant).

ClockMeasurement.description:
A destination clock measurement (ADR-0008 D5 §6.5 item 4): the destination's
clock lags local time by at most `behind_upper_ms`.

behind_upper_ms.description: Upper bound of the destination clock's lag, in milliseconds.

rtt_ms.description: Round trip of the measurement, in milliseconds.

DestinationClock.description:
A pair's destination clock (ADR-0008 D7 item 3). Wire forms:
`{"measured":{…}}` or `"unmeasured"`. Per pair the weakest is shown.
